run_metadata.coverage_summary: Degraded, SEARCH-ONLY run. The hard egress block seen on recent runs persisted: the session network policy denies direct HTTPS to tender hosts (WebFetch to https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm returned DNS ENOTFOUND; per environment guidance no further direct buyer fetches were attempted once the failure was confirmed). No buyer-originated detail page, feed/API or tender document could be opened; discovery was limited to WebSearch (US-indexed, lagging the run date and returning mostly cached snippets and third-party aggregator pages). Tier 1 (AusTender; NSW buy.nsw/eTendering; VIC Buying for Victoria; QLD Brisbane/QTenders->VendorPanel; WA; SA; TAS; NT QTOL; ACT Tenders) swept by search. Tier 2 (local government via VendorPanel and council sites - Colac Otway, Logan, Central Coast, Ipswich, Noosa, East Gippsland; universities - Univ. of Sydney, UWA; water corporations - Sydney/Melbourne Water, Greater Western Water, Power & Water NT) swept by search. Tier 3 MANDATORY check done by search (SAP Ariba Discovery; BHP GCMS; Rio Tinto Ariba; Fortescue/Woodside; ICN Gateway) - every corporate channel remained registration-gated or invitation-only with no publicly-visible open RFx; recorded as portals only, none fabricated. Net: the four still-open, buyer-corroborated carryover opportunities were re-confirmed and re-asserted (NSW ~$80M Master Media RFT closing 27 Nov; Brisbane Gardner Road closing 7 Dec and Prebble St Bikeway closing 11 Dec; TfNSW New England Hwy Maitland Westbound ROI closing 11 Dec, publish date 9 Nov now captured), and two new buyer-portal-listed ACT opportunities were surfaced at headline level (Tenders ACT SL20260630 closing 1 Dec; PIMA0014211 closing 3 Dec). Three genuinely new sources recorded (ICN Gateway; Colac Otway Shire Council; Logan City Council VendorPanel migration). All six tenders are headline-only and UNVERIFIED on an opened buyer page. No opportunity, deliverable, date, value or contact was fabricated.
gaps: HARD EGRESS BLOCK (unchanged from recent runs): all direct HTTPS to tender hosts is denied by the session network policy. WebFetch to https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm returned DNS ENOTFOUND, and the same failure mode applies to every other buyer portal, so no buyer-originated detail page, feed/API or tender document could be opened. To restore full discovery these hosts should be allowed in the session network settings: www.tenders.gov.au, buy.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au, qtenders.hpw.qld.gov.au / supply.qld.gov.au, www.tenders.wa.gov.au, www.tenders.sa.gov.au, www.tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, www.tenders.act.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, service.ariba.com, gateway.icn.org.au, www.brisbane.qld.gov.au, estimateone.com, and individual council/university/utility/corporate sites.

Every tender captured this run is headline-only and UNVERIFIED on the buyer own page. Titles, reference numbers and closing dates come from WebSearch snippets of trade press, buyer-page snapshots and aggregators, not from an opened buyer detail page. Deliverables, requirements, eligibility, evaluation criteria, submission mechanics, value and contacts are therefore null and still need a detail pass once egress is restored.

WebSearch index lags the run date (2026-11-17) and is US-indexed. Almost all other surfaced notices had already closed (e.g. Mona Vale Road West EOI, NSW sustainable-energy EOI closed 5 Mar 2026, Colac Otway grazing-licence EOI closed 30 Oct 2026, HealthShare solar maintenance, NeoSmelt JV closed 18 Dec 2025) and were correctly excluded, NOT captured. Genuinely recent (last 24-48h) buyer-originated notices are almost certainly undercounted.

The two new ACT entries (Tenders ACT SL20260630, PIMA0014211) come from a WebSearch summary of the Tenders ACT open-tenders listing, not an opened record; that same listing snapshot contained at least one garbled release/closing date, so both close dates and the PIMA0014211 procurement_type need confirmation on the live portal once egress is restored.

Several buy.nsw items were surfaced only in a WebSearch summary and could NOT be tied to a citable buyer-page snippet, so they were NOT captured as tenders and must be verified on the buy.nsw Opportunities Hub once egress is restored: a Solar PV Design/Supply/Installation/Maintenance contract reportedly closing 9 Dec 2026; a DPIRD Monitoring, Evaluation, Reporting & Improvement (MERI) Panel reportedly closing 8 Dec 2026; a McMahons Park play-space upgrade reportedly closing 3 Dec 2026; and a DPIRD "Solar carpark awning and ground mounted batteries" RFT (no close date seen). Also unconfirmed: Univ. of Sydney chiller/cooling-tower 2027 EOI; UWA hydraulic/gas services RFT; Greater Western Water RFT26-004 "Sustaining Infrastructure" EOI.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP GCMS, Rio Tinto Ariba, Fortescue, Woodside, ICN Gateway, major retail/bank/telco) remained registration-gated or invitation-only; no authenticated supplier session is available, so no corporate opportunity could be read. Recorded as portals only; no corporate tender fabricated. Management-consultancy / invitation-only RFPs are out of scope by definition and were not invented.
The four re-asserted opportunities are carryovers from earlier runs (existing dedup_keys) re-confirmed as still open via this run searches; they were not freshly discovered this run.
recommended_seed_additions: ICN Gateway (https://gateway.icn.org.au/) - Industry Capability Network portal where major Australian project owners (mining JVs, state infrastructure programs) publish supplier and work-package opportunities; buyer/project-originated, free registration. Not previously in the known-source set.

Colac Otway Shire Council - Tenders & Procurement (https://www.colacotway.vic.gov.au/Council-the-shire/Tenders-Procurement) - Victorian local-government buyer-originated tenders page; add to the local-government sample rotation.

Logan City Council - Tenders and EOI via VendorPanel (https://www.logan.qld.gov.au/business-and-investment/doing-business-with-council/request-for-tenders-and-eoi) - QLD council migrated from TenderLink to VendorPanel; track via its VendorPanel listings.

Once egress is restored, open the buyer detail pages for all six carried/surfaced opportunities (buy.nsw NSW Master Media RFT; Brisbane Doc115483155 and Doc118000917; TfNSW 26.0000139291.0941.ROI; Tenders ACT SL20260630 and PIMA0014211) and the unconfirmed buy.nsw items listed in gaps, and complete the deliverables/requirements detail pass.

discovered_sources.source_name: SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery
discovered_sources.how_discovered: Mandatory Tier 3 check this run. Searched for publicly-visible open Australian RFx on Ariba Discovery; none were visible without a supplier login. Australian buyers (e.g. Opal/Paper Australia, Sydney Water, Brisbane City Council) run sourcing events on Ariba but access is at the invited-supplier-contact level.
discovered_sources.notes: Largest single corporate opportunity channel. Registration-gated: individual RFx require a free supplier account and, typically, a buyer invitation. No publicly-visible open opportunity captured this run; recorded as a portal only, none fabricated.
